transcript.t: Objective reactions design process to design software again. Migratory winger. Principal research scientist with Autodesk Research. My colleague Brian Lee helped put together this presentation but unfortunately wasn't able to attend this year, so I'm going to try to investigate.
transcript.tr: 客观反应设计过程来再次设计软件。迁徙边锋。 Autodesk Research 首席研究科学家。我的同事 Brian Lee 帮助整理了这个演示文稿，但不幸的是今年无法参加，所以我将尝试进行调查。
